title: server-vad-optimisation
description:
Sweep, analysis and adaptive-tuning code, together with the per-session data, for an empirical characterisation of the server-side voice activity detection (VAD) in the OpenAI Realtime API. A face-centred Central Composite Design (19 design points, four replications, 76 sessions) varies the three exposed parameters (threshold, silence_duration_ms, prefix_padding_ms), and second-order response-surface models relate them to the interruptive false-positive rate (FPR) and endpointing latency (TL).

The repository contains the CCD sweep runner (sweep.py), the RSM and Pareto analysis pipeline (analyse_sweep.py), the robustness analyses and figure regeneration for the accompanying paper (papers/paper1/), an adaptive VAD tuner (adaptive_tuner.py), and an in-progress LLM-as-a-Judge extension (judge.py).

This release accompanies the submission "Endpointing Latency versus Interruptive False Positives in Server-Side VAD: A Response-Surface Characterisation of a Production Speech-to-Speech API". Running papers/paper1/make_figures.py regenerates all figures and checks every value reported in the manuscript.
